name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Go-to-Market & Marketing Strategist | Positioning, Narrative & Commercial Execution
summary: Go-to-market and marketing strategist with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments, working between market strategy and the hands-on build. I write the positioning, produce the campaign assets, equip the sales team, and read the performance data myself. At Wix I drove a brand-new vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line and built the sales training behind it. At Solenzo I define messaging frameworks for service-business clients and translate complex technical and data systems into narratives non-technical buyers understand and act on.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Translate complex technical systems, automation logic, and performance data into clear narratives and structured recommendations that non-technical business owners act on.

Develop and execute full-lifecycle customer strategies spanning demand generation, sales CRM architecture, and customer success, aligning marketing programs to revenue objectives directly with owners and sales teams.
Build reusable messaging frameworks and marketing assets, adapting a shared template base to each client's brand, buyer, and vertical rather than starting from scratch each time.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.
Conduct competitor research, keyword gap analyses, and technical audits to identify positioning opportunities and market gaps, then implement the resulting changes directly.
Draft the direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages myself, then track acquisition and retention in GA4 and CRM analytics and use the data to keep iterating.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations backed by tracking across sales enablement, marketing, and operations.

bullets: Managed integrated multi-channel marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, acting as strategic lead and orchestrating execution across internal departments.

Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs to client stakeholders.
Ran keyword and search-term research to shape campaign targeting, audience definition, and content direction.
Translated performance data into strategic recommendations for multi-stakeholder accounts spanning marketing and technology channels.
